name: django_backend
description: Build a production-ready Django + Django REST Framework backend with PostgreSQL, JWT auth, and structured API.
steps: Create project structure: config/ (settings), apps/<appname>/, requirements.txt
Write requirements.txt: django, djangorestframework, djangorestframework-simplejwt, psycopg2-binary, django-cors-headers, python-decouple
Write config/settings.py with split base/dev/prod pattern using python-decouple
Write config/urls.py with API router and auth token endpoints
For each app: write models.py, serializers.py, views.py (ViewSets), urls.py
Write apps/users/ with custom User model extending AbstractBaseUser or AbstractUser
Add JWT auth: configure simplejwt settings, add /api/token/ and /api/token/refresh/ URLs
Add django-cors-headers middleware and CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS config
Run: python manage.py runserver to verify startup
best_practices: Always use a custom User model — never rely on Django's built-in User for a real project
Use ViewSets + Routers — less boilerplate, consistent URL patterns
Separate serializers per use case: CreateSerializer vs ResponseSerializer where they differ
Use python-decouple for environment config — never hardcode secrets
Add pagination to every list endpoint (PageNumberPagination, default 20)
Return consistent error format: {detail: string} or {field: [errors]}
Add django-filter for query param filtering on list endpoints
Use select_related/prefetch_related to avoid N+1 queries
Write a management command for seed data: python manage.py seed_data
Use PostgreSQL in dev too — SQLite differences cause production surprises
